notes: Reset creates bubbles in every stage
MEM waits for daccess_rvalid or daccess_wresp; the response takes an unbounded number of cycles on the AXI and cache path
EX waits for ALU busy to fall; cannot coexist with a branch in EX
Taken branch jal or jalr resolved in EX; the branch itself must advance while the two younger instructions are discarded
ID waits one cycle so the load result can be forwarded from MEM/WB
IF waits for ifetch_valid; the response takes an unbounded number of cycles on the AXI and cache path
Static predict-not-taken; only when no higher-priority event is active
